project_description: A full-stack Massachusetts and New England grid-intelligence demo combining pinned official-source context, a checked synthetic site dispatch comparison, and a clearly simulated AI-report human-approval workflow.

hosting_disclosures.cold_start: The free service may sleep and cold-start, taking up to several minutes to become ready.
hosting_disclosures.ephemeral_storage: State is ephemeral; every boot rebuilds the checked report, simulated approvals are erased, and no persistence is claimed.
hosting_disclosures.free_tier_volatility: Free-tier availability and limits may change without notice.
hosting_disclosures.local_fallback: Run make demo and open http://127.0.0.1:8000.
